subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Aadhaar Data Exposure
description: One-minute skill: The Aadhaar Data Exposure.

hook.text: India's biometric ID system holds data on 1.3 billion people. Reporters bought access for just $8.

buildup.text: Aadhaar stores fingerprints, iris scans, and personal details of virtually every Indian citizen.

discovery.text: Journalists found that unauthorized agents were selling Aadhaar data access through WhatsApp for a few dollars.

twist.text: The Indian government denied security failures and threatened legal action against the reporters instead.

climax.text: The world's largest biometric database was accessible for the price of a meal — and the government denied it.

punchline.text: 1.3 billion identities. Eight dollars for access.

quiz.question: What is India's Aadhaar system?
options: A biometric ID system holding data on 1.3 billion people
A social media platform popular in India
A government email service for citizens
